records.title: FORM 10-Q
records.text: Our asset-based segments contributed approximately 68% of total revenue and 64% of total freight revenue in the quarter.

records.title: FORM 10-Q
records.text: Our asset-light segments contributed approximately 32% of total revenue and 36% of total freight revenue in the quarter.

records.title: FORM 10-Q
records.text: Our Expedited segment grew revenue modestly, through modest growth in the average total tractor count and improved utilization, partially offset by lower rates.

records.title: FORM 10-Q
records.text: Adding to the general market headwinds, used equipment prices continued to decline and adverse weather conditions experienced in January created incremental cost and operational challenges.

records.title: FORM 10-Q
records.text: Although year over year freight revenue growth was modest at 3.6%, operating income improved by approximately 217% due to the combination of improved cost efficiencies and rate increases in our Warehousing reportable segment and improved cargo related claims costs in our Managed Freight segment.
